about_the_game:
ABOUT

Lost in Love is a narrative horror dating sim set in dark wintertime Berlin. Featuring a richly diverse cast of characters, Lost in Love explores vulnerability, loneliness, freedom, and healing topics. This game is about the silly, awkward, deeply human experience of dating, hand-drawn with love.

You play as Nora, a 21-year-old whose heart was shattered by a toxic ex. To forget, you dive into the chaos of the modern Berlin dating scene —sex clubs, raves, late-night heart-to-hearts, laughter, tears, and sudden flashbacks. Juggle work, rest, dates, and the occasional run-back to your ex as you hunt for the forces that have driven you your whole life. Your choices decide who Nora wakes up as the next morning. Just, please, not at her parents’ place.

FEATURES

* Interactive map of Berlin – explore the city’s hidden corners.

* Dating-app simulator – swipe, like, check profiles—just like real life.

* Date simulator – awkward pauses, confessions, risky jokes—the things you never dared.

* Texting simulator – grab a tub of ice cream and talk with your friend about how the date went.

* Outfit selection – dress like a total fool for a date; in Berlin, anything goes!

* Character progression – help Nora level up: empathy, freedom… or wildness? You decide.

content_descriptors.notes:
LOST IN LOVE contains mature subject matter aimed at adults  (18+).
• Occasional non-explicit nudity and suggestive dialogue during dates
• References to sexual activity, including BDSM, and to Berlin’s sex-positive nightlife (no explicit sex, no visible genitals)
• Recreational alcohol and drug use may be mentioned or briefly shown
• Mild profanity and strong emotional themes
• Non-graphic references to past sexual trauma (mentioned only in dialogue & text)

Player discretion is advised, especially for those sensitive to discussions of past abuse, substance use, or intense emotional distress.
